import calendar
def calculate_day_of_month(year, month):
    days_in_month = [0, 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    is_leap = False
    if year % 4 == 0:
        if year % 100 == 0:
            if year % 400 == 0:
                is_leap = True
        else:
            is_leap = False
    if is_leap:
        days_in_month[2] = 29
    if 1 <= month <= 12:
        return days_in_month[month]
    else:
        return -1
